🎒 **GoBag Deep Research Complete** — Project NOMAD + 2TB Update Plan

**Part 1 — NOMAD Ecosystem:**
- 9 Supply Depot apps: Stirling PDF, File Browser, Calibre-Web, IT Tools, Excalidraw, Homebox, Vaultwarden, Jellyfin, **Meshtastic Web** (CRITICAL for comms config)
- 2 community ZIM builders: US Military Field Manuals (~2GB), W3Schools (~700MB)
- NOMAD uses ProtoMaps (PMTiles single-file format) — compatible alongside Mapterhorn
- v1.34.0 adds: Drug Reference built-in, ZIM→RAG ingestion, per-model thinking toggle
- RAG via Qdrant: upload any PDF/docx → AI can answer from it. Huge for field manuals.

**Part 2 — 2TB Manifest (~600GB total, ~1.2TB headroom):**
- AI: Meditron 70B + Llama 3.3 70B + Qwen 2.5 32B + Mistral 7B + nomic-embed (RAG) = ~115GB
- Kiwix: Wikipedia maxi (116GB) + WikiMed + MDWiki + MedlinePlus + Military FMs + Prepper vids = ~160GB
- Maps: ProtoMaps (80GB) + Mapterhorn + LiDAR (100GB) = ~205GB
- Apps + Education + Security = ~100GB

**Part 3 — 1TB (~410GB used, ~390GB headroom):**
- Cut: Wikipedia maxi → mini (saves 104GB), reduce LiDAR, drop Jellyfin archive
- Keep: Meditron 70B, Qwen 2.5 32B, WikiMed+MDWiki, Military FMs, all medical ZIMs, Vaultwarden, Meshtastic Web
- Recommendation: Run NOMAD on 1TB (has RAG, Meshtastic Web, auto-updates). Hermes can co-exist.

**Part 4 — Update Script:**
- Saved to `projects/gobag-update/UPDATE_GOBAG.ps1`
- Modes: full (2TB), lite (1TB), check (dry run)
- Handles: NOMAD compose updates, Kiwix date-based ZIM checks, Ollama model pulls, ProtoMaps
- Logs all updates with timestamps, idempotent

**Files saved:**
- `research/gobag-update-plan.md` — Full research doc with URLs/sizes
- `projects/gobag-update/UPDATE_GOBAG.ps1` — 4-month update script
